  "app_compose": "{\"manifest_version\":2,\"name\":\"glm-openrouter\",\"runner\":\"docker-compose\",\"docker_compose_file\":\"# 1-glm-openrouter — the centralized multi-upstream aggregator, on a CVM with no SSH.\\n#\\n# Control path ported from 19-glm5.3 / 20-qwavity-35b: no SSH channel, every later\\n# change goes through 0g-controller on port 3090. No GPU — the broker forwards to\\n# external upstreams (DashScope anchor + per-model OpenRouter / MiniMax / Tencent /\\n# Baidu), so everything sglang/PIG/dcgm-shaped in 19 is absent here.\\n#\\n# Two things 19's template could not carry unchanged, both in broker-config-init:\\n#   - the aggregator's user_config is ~108 KB stripped; base64 alone is 144 KB and\\n#     dstack caps one encrypted env value at 128 KB. BROKER_CONFIG is therefore\\n#     base64(gzip(user_config)) — ~16 KB — and decoded with `base64 -d | gunzip`.\\n#   - the config holds seven ${...} placeholders, not two: the wallet key, the\\n#     CoinGecko key and FIVE upstream credentials. Each is substituted here at first\\n#     boot from its own encrypted env var; a missing one aborts instead of shipping\\n#     `Authorization: Bearer ${X}` upstream, which 401s on every request while the\\n#     provider still looks healthy.\\n#\\n# Ports published: 443 (ingress), 80 (broker, what the ingress fronts), 3090\\n# (controller). mysql / prometheus / grafana publish nothing.\\n#\\n# After the first boot, editing user_config and redeploying the dstack app does\\n# nothing — broker-config-init only writes an empty volume. Config changes go\\n# `./redeploy.sh 1-glm-openrouter` -> controller PUT /v1/config/core (permanent).\\n# Image changes via the controller revert at the next CVM boot; compose changes\\n# are a dstack redeploy.\\n\\nx-logging: &default-logging\\n  driver: \\\"json-file\\\"\\n  options:\\n    max-size: \\\"50m\\\"\\n    max-file: \\\"3\\\"\\n\\nservices:\\n  broker-ingress:\\n    logging: *default-logging\\n    image: dstacktee/dstack-ingress:2.2@sha256:d05a7b343c37c1cca1bba8dbf7e8f3c6d2118158af2d41c455103796db4f67f0\\n    ports:\\n      - \\\"443:443\\\"\\n    environment:\\n      - CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}\\n      - DOMAIN=${DOMAIN:?set DOMAIN — make-secrets.py emits it from service.servingUrl}\\n      - TARGET_ENDPOINT=http://0g-serving-provider-broker:3080\\n      - CERTBOT_EMAIL=${CERTBOT_EMAIL}\\n      - GATEWAY_DOMAIN=_.${DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN}\\n      - SET_CAA=true\\n      - PORT=443\\n      - TIMEOUT_CONNECT=10s\\n      - TIMEOUT_SERVER=900s\\n    volumes:\\n      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock\\n      - cert-data:/etc/letsencrypt\\n    restart: unless-stopped\\n    # The ingress claims the DNS record as its first act, so gating it on a healthy\\n    # broker is what makes a same-servingUrl cutover make-before-break.\\n    depends_on:\\n      0g-serving-provider-broker:\\n        condition: service_healthy\\n\\n  mysql:\\n    logging: *default-logging\\n    image: mysql:8.0@sha256:7dcddc01f13bab2f15cde676d44d01f61fc9f99fe7785e86196dfc07d358ae2b\\n    restart: unless-stopped\\n    environment:\\n      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=123456\\n      - MYSQL_DATABASE=provider\\n      - MYSQL_USER=provider\\n      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=provider\\n    volumes:\\n      - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql\\n    healthcheck:\\n      test: [\\\"CMD-SHELL\\\", \\\"mysql -uroot -p123456 -e 'USE provider'\\\"]\\n      interval: 15s\\n      timeout: 5s\\n      retries: 15\\n      start_period: 60s\\n    networks:\\n      - default\\n\\n  # Writes /config/config.yaml exactly once, on a CVM whose volume is empty.\\n  broker-config-init:\\n    logging: *default-logging\\n    image: alpine:3.18@sha256:de0eb0b3f2a47ba1eb89389859a9bd88b28e82f5826b6969ad604979713c2d4f\\n    environment:\\n      - BROKER_CONFIG=${BROKER_CONFIG:-}\\n      - PRIVATE_KEY=${PRIVATE_KEY:-}\\n      - COINGECKO_API_KEY=${COINGECKO_API_KEY:-}\\n      - AUTHORIZATION=${AUTHORIZATION:-}\\n      - OPENROUTER_AUTHORIZATION=${OPENROUTER_AUTHORIZATION:-}\\n      - TENCENT_AUTHORIZATION=${TENCENT_AUTHORIZATION:-}\\n      - MINIMAX_AUTHORIZATION=${MINIMAX_AUTHORIZATION:-}\\n      - BAIDU_AUTHORIZATION=${BAIDU_AUTHORIZATION:-}\\n    volumes:\\n      - broker-config:/config\\n    command:\\n      - sh\\n      - -c\\n      - |\\n        set -e\\n        if [ ! -f /config/config.yaml ]; then\\n          if [ -z \\\"$$BROKER_CONFIG\\\" ]; then\\n            echo \\\"BROKER_CONFIG is empty and no config exists yet\\\" >&2\\n            exit 1\\n          fi\\n          printf '%s' \\\"$$BROKER_CONFIG\\\" | base64 -d | gunzip > /config/config.yaml.tmp\\n          # Same list make-secrets.py refuses to emit without. `g`: the Baidu and\\n          # Tencent keys each appear on a dozen-plus models.\\n          for name in PRIVATE_KEY COINGECKO_API_KEY AUTHORIZATION OPENROUTER_AUTHORIZATION TENCENT_AUTHORIZATION MINIMAX_AUTHORIZATION BAIDU_AUTHORIZATION; do\\n            eval \\\"value=\\\\$$$$name\\\"\\n            if [ -z \\\"$$value\\\" ]; then\\n              echo \\\"$$name is empty — refusing to install a config that would send it upstream as a literal\\\" >&2\\n              exit 1\\n            fi\\n            sed -i \\\"s#\\\\$${$${name}}#$$value#g\\\" /config/config.yaml.tmp\\n          done\\n          if grep -q '\\\\$${' /config/config.yaml.tmp; then\\n            echo \\\"unresolved placeholder left in config:\\\" >&2\\n            grep -o '\\\\$${[A-Za-z_0-9]*}' /config/config.yaml.tmp | sort -u >&2\\n            exit 1\\n          fi\\n          mv /config/config.yaml.tmp /config/config.yaml\\n        fi\\n    restart: \\\"no\\\"\\n\\n  0g-serving-provider-broker:\\n    logging: *default-logging\\n    container_name: 0g-serving-provider-broker\\n    image: ghcr.io/0gfoundation/0g-serving-broker@sha256:c51266405244225dc77e029a842f8a3c046e5cd28512688802e414b8411b1ac5\\n    ports:\\n      - \\\"80:3080\\\"\\n    environment:\\n      - PORT=3080\\n      - CONFIG_FILE=/etc/config/config.yaml\\n      # Compose literals so compose_hash covers them. TARGET_URL is the ANCHOR\\n      # (DashScope) upstream only — the per-model targetUrls of the non-Alibaba\\n      # legs live in user_config and are not attested this way.\\n      - TARGET_URL=https://ws-ck3ccdg8ka3n5uvy.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1\\n      -
